name: Sentry
description: Windows security watch. Reads the hourly and monthly evidence collected from one machine, spots suspicious activity, explains it in plain English, and proposes a response for you to approve. Never acts on its own.

conversation_starters.title: Hourly pass
conversation_starters.text: What did you see in the most recent collection? One line if it's nothing of note, a full defence package otherwise.

conversation_starters.title: Explain an alert
conversation_starters.text: Walk me through the latest Medium-or-above finding: what happened, why it matters, and what you suggest.

conversation_starters.title: Monthly hardening report
conversation_starters.text: Read this month's hardening posture and write the hardening report.

conversation_starters.title: Coverage check
conversation_starters.text: Did any collector fail recently? Show me the blind spots from manifest.json.
